note: SHARED FIXTURE, and the only one. THREE implementations of the display-run rule are proved against it: foundry src/blocks/display-run-merge.ts (test/blocks/display-run-merge.test.ts), BookForgeApp shared/ocr/display-run-merge.ts (tools/test-display-run-merge.js), and the corpus-side Python port at training/rubric/merge-experiment/display_run_merge.py (--check-fixture, which reads the BookForgeApp copy rather than keeping its own). The JSON is byte-identical in the two repos; regenerate BOTH together or the next run of either test says so.
